target: Zhou/Dunning length constraints: exact source panel and projection conventions pending.
limitations: Own physical-field/KS variant, not the original three-field formulation; mesh resolution and grey fields prevent a universal minimum-size certificate. Until 29 October 2026 the indicator penalised every cone average below 1 instead of below the threshold: the inside corners of every junction then violated it, so even a truss of wide members was infeasible and the optimiser kept 1-cell members. The constraints are switched in gradually (tolerance 64 times larger at the start, halved every 40 steps) while a projection sharpens to beta 16 (doubled every 60), as in Zhou et al.; started at full strength on a grey field every cell violates and MMA barely moves. The medial-line detector uses a decay of 0.3 times (R/h)^4: at 1 a short thin member between two solid regions escaped, because the average rises along it. Without the constraints the same problem keeps members 1-2 mm wide.

checks.scope: Objective, budget and every extra constraint at one smooth deterministic direction. Stress adaptive scale disabled only in the probe; eigenvalue reference and AL multipliers held fixed. Not certification at switches/repeated modes.
